subject: koala
pitch:
Category: Animal.
Subject: koala gripping a eucalyptus branch stand.
Style: pixel art.
reasoning:
Looking at the renders, I notice the koala isn't actually gripping the branch properly—it's floating in front of the Y-shaped fork with arms splayed sideways like wings instead of wrapping around the trunk, and the depth positioning between the koala's body and the branch geometry doesn't create real contact.

The arm sweeps are rendering as messy angular shards rather than clean limbs; I should replace them with rigid box-based rods for the upper arm and forearm segments between shoulder, elbow, and wrist joints, using the same approach for legs. The V-shaped fork is also too wide, making the koala look like it has antlers rather than sitting in a tree crotch—I need to narrow that branch angle.

Still working out limb and hand positions...

The sitting pose checks out — body bottom rests on the crotch box top, so the trunk connects fine to the body in the render. The leaf cards look oversized and ragged though, overlapping the head in the side view, so I should shrink them to [0.06,0.14] and reduce the count, especially near the fork tips at head height.

I'm also going to limit the twig z-range so decorations don't drift into the face, and taller the limbs so leaves clear the head — reworking the arm point formula with new height and spread values, and rescaling the model proportionally.

Checking wrist placement against body bounds, I find the limb is clipping slightly into the torso at that joint, so I'm increasing the slope by widening the spread value, which pushes the wrist and elbow x-coordinates outward enough to clear the body edge.

Knee and ankle positions check out fine, and the head crown clearance looks good too, leaving room for leaf cards above the head. Now I'm switching the arm sweep geometry to use tapered frustum boxes between the bone joints instead of plain sweeps, so I need to define the shoulder-elbow-wrist point constants to pass into that frustum function.

Adding a small cube at the elbow joint to smooth over the seam, and bumping the eye size slightly from 0.034 to 0.042 since koala eyes should still read as small but a touch more visible. Skipping any glow or extra sky effects — now I'm moving on to writing out the actual edit blocks, making sure each search string matches the existing code exactly.

Writing arm geometry edits...

Adjusting elbow fluff position and wrist frustum bone attachment, then tweaking the twig direction vector and leaf sizing for natural variation.

I'm shrinking leaf dimensions and reducing tip leaf count slightly, keeping twig taper values consistent with the taller limb proportions. Finally enlarging the eye and brow geometry a bit while leaving the mouth and other facial marks unchanged.
